trigger: Statistical results must be communicated to technical or nontechnical stakeholders.
steps: Restate the estimand/question, target population/design and exact analysis/data version.
Select tables/visuals that expose effect magnitude, uncertainty and relevant diagnostics rather than only favorable point estimates.
Separate descriptive, predictive and causal claims.
Explain assumptions, missingness, multiplicity, sensitivity and material analysis deviations at the level needed by the audience.
Translate statistical uncertainty into bounded decision-relevant language without choosing the domain decision.
Preserve reproducible links to data/code/results and record unanswered domain questions.
forbidden: Present p-values alone as importance or causality.
Choose policy/product/business action by statistical authority.
